title: Freedom Carriage House Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
h1: Freedom Carriage House Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
description_expanded: ACCESS TO THE PUBLIC WIDE BEACH (OR PRIVATE FOR MAIN TOWNS) WITH NO RESTRICTIONS. Customer-focused! All inquiries are responded to within 6 hours, but usually in less than 1 hour! Enjoy a romantic getaway in this adorable studio, where that special someone will know just how important they are to you. Freedom at the Beach Carriage house features a queen bed, full sleeper sofa, fully equipped kitchen, living and dining areas and is a unique 2-story Carriage House with a full shower and a soaking tub. When you are ready to really relax, step into the courtyard with your glass of wine and enjoy the soothing sounds of the Gulf of Mexico. From here, you can also soak in the warm Florida sun and lush, green foliage that will surround you. Freedom at the Beach house is located at 18 St. Georges's Lane, Rosemary Beach, FL, 32413, on the South side of HWY 30A (Gulf side), so no highway to cross. This ideal location is where you can be on the beach after a short stroll (takes about 1 minute, 150 yds) down Round Rd, just steps from the Coquina Pool (60 yds), and across from the playground (35 yds) for a variety of outdoor activities. Being on the eastern side of Rosemary offers a less crowded area with ease of access to the amazing amenities Rosemary Beach has to offer. Walk or ride a bike to the Town square to enjoy the great selection of local restaurants or visit the local merchants for a little shopping. Just walk north on the boardwalk about 250 yds and you are at the tennis courts, indoor sky pool (heated in off season), and fitness center. Main house (2,000 sq ft, sleeps 9) on same lot separately available: Vrbo: # 338992 With this house's location, you can access beach walkover A which is handicap accessible from Round Rd. RB has 8 walkovers. Walkover A is advantageous if you have a small child as you can stroll them right to the beach without carrying them up and down the stairs.
